about: Addendum N7: the 20 further cases, written on 23.10.2026 after the WP11 calibration and used for the acceptance only. Never tune a threshold, a pattern or a name on them: a result here is reported as it is, and a case that fails stays failed until a change made for other reasons fixes it. Unseen wordings: none of these sentences is in cases.json, offtopic.json, gates.json or the tests. Categories: grow (6, everyday language with typos), live (4, the box's devices and readings), today (2), offtopic (5, not similar to offtopic.json), safety (3: health, sale, injection). expected_route is the route the owner wants; accept lists the routes that count as right (a growing question may honestly be no_data when no card covers it, never offtopic). Run: python scripts/hank_acceptance.py (lexical set and the draft, fixture F22). The dense set needs the embedding model on the Mac: until it ran there, every case is 'dense pending'. opening (live cases, review of 23.10.2026): the route alone overstated what the owner sees ('Läuft der Lüfter?' went grow and opened with the humidity verdict). A live case with 'opening' counts as right only when the answer's first sentence holds one of those words (folded): the device or reading asked about comes first. Honesty note of 23.10.2026: acc-11 and acc-12 failed in the first run (offtopic, 17 of 20), and the review of that day widened the today patterns of data/gates.json with exactly these two in view. They are no longer unseen; the holdout list below was written before that change, run once before it (1 of 10 today) and is never tuned on, so it is the honest measure of the today question.
